messages.subject: Invalid blocks with .findSpatialBlocks
messages.body_plain:
Hello Kylie,

I am trying DESI-Orbitrap imaging and am creating image files by converting .RAW files (each is a full row in a flyback raster pattern) to .mzML files, then those to .imzML image files using GNPS' converter (https://gnps-quickstart.ucsd.edu/conversion) and Alan Race's imzMLConverter, respectively. The image data can be normalized, smoothed, etc. and false color images made without issue. However, when I try to perform spatial shrunken centroids or spatially aware k-means clustering, I get the error "Error in .findSpatialBlocks(.object, groups = run(.object), nblocks = .blocks,  :
  invalid blocks". Is there some way to fix this?

messages.subject: Re: Invalid blocks with .findSpatialBlocks
messages.body_plain:
This usually occurs due to an extraneous z-dimension in the coordinates in previous versions of Cardinal. Upgrading to a newer version 2.6 in BioC 3.11 will fix it. To stay on an older version, you can remove the z-dimension:

coord(mse)$z <- NULL

-Kylie

messages.subject: Extract intensity from a predefined m/z list
messages.subject_clean: Extract intensity from a predefined m/z list
messages.body_plain:
Hello Cardinal users,

I am reaching you regarding an issue concerning peak picking.
To put the context : I have several MSI analysis (one per sample) over a year and in order to process my data for statistical analysis I need to create a data frame for each of my sample where the columns are the same m/z for all my samples.

The idea is therefore :
- to extract a global list of m/z taking into consideration all the m/z detected in all my samples and that combine the m/z that close (10ppm) . I already managed to do it with MALDIquant but I cannot pursue for what I want to do after. Can we do it too with Cardinal ?

- For each sample, create an intensity data frame where the lines correspond to the pixels of the sample and the columns are the different m/z from my combined reference list.

Can anyone help me with these issues ? And how to process peak picking based on a reference list created upon several samples ?

Thanks a lot in advance !

Marie
